when.quote: Every Rho-Bank credit card earns rewards on all purchases, but certain categories of spending may earn you bonus rewards at a higher rate.

info.about: Whether the card is for personal or business spending. This decides whether personal or business cards are candidates.
info.ask: Is this card for your personal everyday spending or for a business?

info.about: Where the customer's spending goes, such as everyday purchases, travel or software, and whether another card already covers any of it (for example, a corporate card that pays for work travel).
info.ask: What do you mainly plan to use the card for? Are any categories, like travel, already paid by another card such as an employer card?

info.about: Whether the customer will accept a card that has an annual fee.
info.ask: Would you consider a card with an annual fee, or do you want a card with no annual fee?

info.about: Whether the customer has an active Rho-Bank+ (Rho Bank Plus) subscription, from any source. The Gold Rewards Card requires one.
info.ask: Do you currently have an active Rho-Bank+ premium subscription?

info.about: Whether the customer has received an invitation for the Diamond Elite Card.
info.ask: Have you received an invitation from Rho-Bank for the Diamond Elite Card?

info.about: The customer's annual income. The customer's apply_for_credit_card tool asks for it.

steps.do: Ask for each missing item in info before comparing cards: personal or business use, main spending categories and any that another card already covers, annual fee tolerance, Rho-Bank+ subscription and Diamond Elite invitation. No identity check is needed because no customer records are read.
steps.quote: Each credit card has its own bonus categories with higher reward rates.

steps.do: Get the current time. This shows whether any promotion window, such as the Platinum first-year fee waiver, is still open.
steps.if: a fee-waiver promotion would affect the comparison
steps.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

steps.do: Compare all personal cards: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond Elite, Crypto-Cash Back and EcoCard. Use each card's earn rate on the customer's actual spending, its annual fee and its eligibility rules (Rho-Bank+ for Gold, invitation for Diamond Elite). Drop cards the customer is not eligible for and cards with fees the customer will not accept. Pick the highest earn rate that is left.
steps.quote: Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.

steps.do: Recommend the chosen card and explain why: its earn rate, its annual fee and any requirement such as Rho-Bank+. Give only public product terms. If the customer rejects every card that fits, say so and do not push.
The customer applies for the recommended card with their own tool.
steps.quote: Complete the application in your Rho‑Bank dashboard and consent to a credit pull (minimum score: $720).

rules.rule: Bronze Rewards Card: 1.0% cash back on everything, annual fee $0.00, minimum credit score 640.
rules.quote: You earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases.

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card: 4.0% on travel and software, 1.0% on everything else, annual fee $0.00. If travel is paid by another card, Silver earns only 1.0% on everyday spending.
rules.quote: Pay with your card for eligible travel and software transactions to earn 4.0% back

rules.rule: Silver Rewards Card earns 1.0% on purchases outside its travel and software categories.
rules.quote: Purchases outside top categories earn 1.0% back

rules.rule: Gold Rewards Card: 2.5% cash back on all purchases and annual fee $0.00.
Gold Rewards Card requires an active Rho-Bank+ subscription; only recommend it if the customer has one.
Gold Rewards Card minimum credit score is 720.
Platinum Rewards Card: 10.0% on all purchases but annual fee $200.00. Do not recommend it to a customer who refuses annual fees while a no-fee card is available.
rules.quote: You earn 10.0% cash back on all eligible purchases.

rules.rule: Platinum Rewards Card has a $200.00 annual fee.
The Platinum first-year fee waiver applies only to applications made between 2024-06-01 and 2024-12-31. The $200.00 fee applies after the first year either way.
rules.quote: The waiver applies to the first 12 months from account opening; after the first anniversary, the standard $200.00 annual fee applies.

rules.rule: Diamond Elite Card: 5.0% on all purchases, by invitation only, annual fee $495.00. Customers cannot apply without an invitation.
Crypto-Cash Back: 2.0% on purchases, annual fee $75.00.
rules.quote: Do I need to pay an annual fee to access the rewards program? Annual fee: $75.00 dollars.

rules.rule: EcoCard earns sustainability points (5 per dollar on green purchases, 1 per dollar otherwise), not cash back, and has a $50.00 annual fee.

For a customer who wants the highest cash back on everyday purchases with no annual fee and has Rho-Bank+, the Gold Rewards Card (2.5%, $0 fee) beats Bronze (1%) and Silver (1% outside travel and software). Without Rho-Bank+, use the same comparison among the remaining cards.
rules.quote: Earn 2.5% cash back on all purchases.

jobs.done_when: The customer has a recommendation based on all personal cards' rates, fees and eligibility, and has either applied with apply_for_credit_card or declined.

documents.why: Bronze fee, credit score and terms.
Silver fee, base 1% rate, premium subscription foreign transaction fee.
Gold 2.5%, $0 fee, Rho-Bank+ required, minimum score 720.
Platinum $200 annual fee and minimum score 750.
How reward categories apply across cards.
Rho Bank Plus membership ($4.99/month), which the Gold card requires.

open_questions: No internal document gives a procedure for recommending a credit card; the comparison rests on each product's own pages.
The documents do not say whether an employer-provided Rho-Bank+ subscription counts for the Gold card requirement; it is treated as an active subscription.
Customers' credit scores cannot be checked; minimum scores can only be stated, not confirmed.
